answer: To sell an inherited car, bring the death certificate and the court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate (letters testamentary or letters of administration); if there are several heirs, the executor signs. For a missing North Carolina title, a duplicate can be requested by mail or at any North Carolina motor vehicle office with the registration and a photo ID, and it takes 4 to 6 weeks to arrive. You can get an offer and book an appointment while you wait, but we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives, and you may need a new offer since offers last a limited time. The help center doesn't cover selling a car that still has a loan, or how the loan affects getting the title, so please contact a store about that part.
